title: scroll
description: `scroll` scrolls the X or Y axis of a named or current canvas in steps or to an absolute position, using messages such as `xaxis`, `yaxis`, `xpos`, and `ypos`. With no canvas-name argument it targets the current canvas, and it only works when that canvas is scrollable; `norm` selects normalized 0–1 positioning, while `page` switches step scrolling from units to pages.
